item.description: Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Plant Relying on Generators Again After Losing Internal Power Supply

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Official Data Shows 450,000 Russians Killed in War, Death Rate Accelerating – Rosstat Leaks
item.description: The war in Ukraine has become the fourth most common cause of death in Russia since 2022, according to official statistics released by hackers.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Russian Diplomats and Military Officials to Join Talks with U.S. and Ukraine, Kremlin Says
item.description: Kremlin aide Vladimir Mendinsky will lead a delegation of Russian officials in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday and Wednesday.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Russia Pounds Power Facilities Around Kyiv, Damages Major Bridge
item.description: With temperatures reaching freezing in the Ukrainian capital, Russian energy strikes are putting Ukraine's heating system under strain.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Anti-Kremlin Political Parties Peaceful Russia and Rassvet Named ‘Foreign Agents’
item.description: Rassvet, founded by 2024 presidential hopeful Yekaterina Duntsova, denied allegations that it received foreign funding.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Russian Security Council Calls for Rapid Deployment of Starlink Rival Satellites
item.description: A group of experts on the council warned that Elon Musk's satellite network could be used to destabilize countries throughout the world.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Father and Daughter Who Fled Russia Win Magnitsky Human Rights Award
item.description: The organization behind the annual honor said the Moskalyovs received the “Courage Under Fire” award for their refusal to remain silent in the face of state prosecution.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Communist Lawmaker Slams Culture Ministry Over Lenin Library Rave
item.description: The Russian State Library, popularly known as “Leninka,” hosted the literary-themed rave on Halloween together with Russia’s largest publishing group.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Rare Thundersnow Strikes Ural Mountains, Ripping Off Roofs and Causing Power Outages
item.description: At least one person was reportedly killed in a highway traffic accident in the Sverdlovsk region on Friday morning due to icy road conditions.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Kremlin Accuses Europe of Struggling to Decide Who Will Represent It in Future Security Talks
item.description: Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said messaging from officials in Brussels suggests that Europe is still unwilling to engage with Russia in serious discussions.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure
item.description: In the southern Krasnodar region, drone debris was reported to have crashed into the Afipsky oil refinery and sparked a fire.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire
item.description: The U.S. president did not disclose what he discussed with envoy Kirill Dmitriev, but he predicted a deal to end the war in Ukraine could emerge soon.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Pro-War Blogger Vanishes From Public After Telegram Post About Oleshky Evacuation
item.description: Vladimir Romanov posted and then later deleted a message on his channel that said only four buses filled with residents from Oleshky had departed for Russia during the ceasefire, as opposed to 17 buses that carried evacuees to Ukrainian territory.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Kremlin Seizes Japan Tobacco International’s Russian Assets
item.description: The move against the Japanese tobacco giant comes amid a sharp deterioration of relations between Japan and Russia.

item.title: [The Moscow Times News] Moscow Denies It’s Behind Freezer Attacks at European Supermarkets
item.description: Hackers have targeted European supermarket refrigeration units in recent weeks, turning up temperatures and spoiling millions of euros worth of frozen goods.
